name: extenshi
description: Research browser extensions across Chrome, Firefox and Edge with the Extenshi catalog, and get help building and shipping your own: icons, manifests, store-readiness checks, browser-change checks, tests, translations and payments. For a signed-in developer the connector also changes their own Extenshi account: it publishes and takes down hosted pages, removes registered URLs and custom domains, edits projects and forms, rotates project keys, and proposes payment changes that apply only after the owner approves them.
